title: 第1章 一觉醒来穿成又胖又丑的炮灰第2章 一贫如洗
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
“你个死丫头，自己胖的跟头肥猪一样，能有人嫁就不错了。你居然还寻死。”
“你知不知道这些年我因为你被人家戳了多少脊梁骨？”
“別以为躺在床上装死就能躲过去，你要是不嫁，看我怎么收拾你！”
苏灿躺在床上，听著耳边骂骂咧咧的声音，头痛欲裂，难受的要死。
她已经穿到这具身体里两个多小时了，一直在消化这狗血的剧情。
谁能想到，昨晚的她作为贴身保鏢还在保护一个大人物，结果消息走漏她被人打了黑枪。
睁开眼就发现穿越到了一本年代文里成了又胖又丑的炮灰。
原主也叫苏灿，跟著母亲姜玉容改嫁到了杨家。
因为继妹杨雅丽生的白净又好看，对比之下原主的母亲对苏灿越来越討厌，再加上背地里总有人拿原主黑胖丑指指点点，原主很快便成了母亲的眼中钉。
这次喝药自杀是继妹杨雅丽的军人未婚夫陆战东，在执行任务时伤了双腿，据说终生残疾再也站不起来了。
可杨家已经拿了陆家的彩礼，自行车手錶缝纫机，加起来就是四百块了。还有之前两百块的彩礼，姜玉容自然不想还回去，可军婚又不能隨便退，便把主意打在了苏灿的身上。
逼著她嫁给那个已经残疾的陆战东。
这样既不用还钱，还能把这个又丑又胖的女儿给送出去，简直是一举两得。
苏灿回忆了一下书里的情节，原主喝药后確实被抢救了过来，可她还是不同意嫁过去，结果被姜玉容这个亲生母亲活生生饿了半个月。
奄奄一息的时候找人送去了陆家，因为天气太热原主得了重病，直接死在了陆战东所在的村头。
而苏灿在这本书里存在的价值，竟然就是为了日后女主用她的死来证明杨雅丽一家的自私自利和冷酷无情。
苏灿仔细算了一下，从现在到距离原主病死也就半个月的时间。
好傢伙，前世刚被人打了黑枪，好不容易有了第二次生的希望，居然又要面临被饿死病死的命运。
不就是个嫁个残疾吗？
她嫁就是了。

“妈……我嫁……”
苏灿努力睁开了眼睛，看著旁边骂骂咧咧的姜玉容开了口。
姜玉容一愣，以为自己耳朵听错了：“死丫头，你再说一遍！”
“妈，我愿意替杨雅丽……嫁给陆战东……”
姜玉容紧盯著她：“这可是你说的！不准反悔！”
“死过一次……我想明白了。”
姜玉容脸上这才有了笑容：“你个死丫头，总算是明事理一回。你好好休息，过两天我亲自送你去车站。”
她是一天也不想看到这个又丑又胖的死丫头待在家里了。
要不是看在苏灿现在动弹不得的份上，姜玉容恨不得现在就把她送到陆家去了。
“你得给我准备一千块钱。”
陆战东腿伤了之后便被送回了农村老家，她身无分文嫁过去肯定是不行的。
“一千块钱？你个死妮子，你抢钱呀！一分没有！”
姜玉容一听就炸毛了，她现在一分都不想在这个死妮子身上。
“你也知道我这个体格饭量大，去他们那里之前怎么也得买些吃的东西。我要是吃不饱半路上跑回来，那就不是我的错了。”
她可不是傻子，杨雅丽既然不愿意嫁到陆战东的村子，肯定是生活条件好不到哪儿去。
再说了，当初陆战东陆陆续续给杨家买了很多东西，她绝对不能便宜了杨家。
“你个死丫头，你是不当家不知道柴米贵是吧？咱家一共都没有一千块！”
话虽是这样说，姜玉容手里自然是有些存款的。
但钱再多她也不愿意在这个胖女儿身上多一分！
content_en:
"You damn girl, you are as fat as a fat pig. It would be great if you could find someone to marry. You are still seeking death."
"Do you know how many times my spine has been stabbed because of you over the years?"
"Don't think you can escape by lying on the bed and pretending to be dead. If you don't marry, see how I deal with you!"
Su Can was lying on the bed, listening to the curses in his ears, having a splitting headache and feeling extremely uncomfortable.
She has been in this body for more than two hours and has been digesting this bloody plot.
Who would have thought that last night she was protecting a big shot as a personal bodyguard, but the news leaked that she was shot.
When I opened my eyes, I found that I had traveled through time and became a fat and ugly cannon fodder in a period novel.
The original owner, also named Su Can, remarried to the Yang family with his mother Jiang Yurong.
Because the stepsister Yang Yali was fair and good-looking, the original owner's mother became more and more disgusted with Su Can. In addition, there were always people criticizing the original owner behind his back for being fat, ugly, and the original owner soon became a thorn in her mother's side.
The suicide by drinking pills was caused by Lu Zhandong, the military fiancé of step-sister Yang Yali. He injured his legs while performing a mission and was said to be permanently disabled and unable to stand up again.
But the Yang family had already received the Lu family’s gift, a bicycle, watch, and sewing machine, which totaled four hundred yuan. There was also the previous gift of two hundred yuan. Jiang Yurong naturally didn't want to give it back, but she couldn't just withdraw from the military wedding, so she set her sights on Su Can.
Forcing her to marry the disabled Lu Zhandong.
This way, I don't have to pay back the money, and I can also give away my ugly and fat daughter. It's like killing two birds with one stone.
Su Can recalled the plot in the book. The original owner was indeed rescued after drinking medicine, but she still refused to marry her. As a result, she was starved to death by Jiang Yurong, her biological mother, for half a month.
When he was dying, someone was sent to the Lu family. Because the weather was too hot, the original owner became seriously ill and died directly in the village where Lu Zhandong was.
The value of Su Can's existence in this book is actually for the heroine to use her death to prove the selfishness and ruthlessness of Yang Yali's family.
Su Can calculated carefully and found that it would only be half a month until the original owner died of illness.
Good guy, I had just been shot in the past life, and I finally had hope for a second life, but I was faced with the fate of starving to death and dying of illness.
Isn’t it just a matter of marrying a disabled person?
Just marry her.
"Mom...I will marry..."
Su Can tried his best to open his eyes, looked at Jiang Yurong who was cursing next to him, and spoke.
Jiang Yurong was stunned, thinking that her ears heard it wrong: "Damn girl, say it again!"
"Mom, I am willing to marry Lu Zhandong for Yang Yali..."
Jiang Yurong stared at her: "This is what you said! Don't go back on it!"
"I died once...I figured it out."
Only then did a smile appear on Jiang Yurong's face: "You damn girl, finally you are sensible for once. You have a good rest, and I will personally take you to the station in two days."
She didn't want to see this ugly, fat, dead girl staying at home for another day.
If it weren't for Su Can's immobility, Jiang Yurong would have sent her to the Lu family right now.
"You have to prepare a thousand dollars for me."
After Lu Zhandong injured his leg, he was sent back to his hometown in the countryside. It would be impossible for her to marry penniless.
"One thousand yuan? You damn girl, you're stealing money! Not even a penny!"
Jiang Yurong was furious when she heard this. She didn't want to be with this damn girl now.
"You also know that I have a big appetite, so I have to buy something to eat before I go to their place. If I run back half way without eating, it's not my fault."
She is not a fool. Since Yang Yali is unwilling to marry into Lu Zhandong's village, her living conditions must not be much better.
Besides, Lu Zhan and Donglu had successively bought a lot of things for the Yang family, so she definitely couldn't take advantage of the Yang family.
"Damn youGirl, you are not a householder and you don’t know that firewood and rice are expensive, right? Our family doesn’t have a thousand yuan in total! "
Having said that, Jiang Yurong naturally has some savings in hand.
But no matter how much money she has, she is not willing to spend any more on this fat daughter!
